Decide whether the following statements about rounding to one decimal place are true or false.

atoms.a: The nearest tenths to 2.73 are 2.3 and 2.7.
If you have to round a decimal number to one decimal place, you should look at the digit in the second decimal place.
2.73 is rounded down to 2.7 because the digit in the second decimal place is smaller than 5.
6.51 is rounded up to 6.6 because the digit in the first decimal place is equal to or greater than 5.
